mainEntity.name: What is Google Ads and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads is a paid advertising platform by Google that allows businesses to show ads on search results, YouTube, and partner websites. You only pay when users click on your ad (PPC model), making it a performance-based marketing strategy.

mainEntity.name: How much does Google Ads cost in India and Indore?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads cost depends on your industry, competition, keywords, and targeting. Businesses in India can start with flexible budgets, and in Indore many companies begin with monthly PPC plans based on lead generation goals.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can Google Ads generate leads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads can start generating traffic and leads within 24–72 hours after campaign launch. With proper optimization, results improve over time, leading to higher conversions and better ROI.

mainEntity.name: Is Google Ads better than SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads provides immediate visibility and fast results, while SEO builds long-term organic traffic. The best strategy for businesses is to combine both for maximum growth and consistent lead generation.

mainEntity.name: Do Google Ads work for small businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads is highly effective for small businesses because it targets users actively searching for products or services, ensuring high-quality leads and better conversion rates.

mainEntity.name: What is the ROI of Google Ads campaigns?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads ROI depends on targeting, ad quality, landing page experience, and bidding strategy. With proper campaign management, businesses can achieve high returns through optimized lead generation.

mainEntity.name: Why should I hire a Google Ads agency in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional Google Ads agency helps you reduce ad spend wastage, improve targeting, optimize keywords, increase conversions, and manage campaigns efficiently for better performance and ROI.

mainEntity.name: What services are included in Google Ads management?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads management includes keyword research, campaign setup, ad copy creation, bidding strategy, A/B testing, conversion tracking, remarketing, and continuous optimization.

mainEntity.name: Can Google Ads target specific locations like Indore or India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads allows precise geo-targeting, enabling businesses to show ads in specific cities like Indore, states, or across India based on their target audience.

mainEntity.name: How do you optimize Google Ads campaigns for better performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads optimization includes improving keyword quality, adjusting bids, refining ad copy, optimizing landing pages, tracking conversions, and removing irrelevant traffic sources.
